in_hebrew.name: Arlan
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Arlan הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old High German 'aralan' meaning 'ruler, eagle warrior'. Arlan carries the strong and regal connotations of both eagles and rulers.

in_greek.name: Arlan
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Eagle ruler
in_greek.long_meaning: Arlan είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from Old High German 'aralan' meaning 'ruler, eagle warrior'. Arlan carries the strong and regal connotations of both eagles and rulers.

in_latin.name: Arlan
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Eagle ruler
in_latin.long_meaning: Arlan est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from Old High German 'aralan' meaning 'ruler, eagle warrior'. Arlan carries the strong and regal connotations of both eagles and rulers.
